title: Making a fan-made card battler using characters from different universes.
author: adrocz
selftext:
So as the title says, I've been working on my game called [Paralleliverse](https://card-forge-lac.vercel.app/), originally called card Forge (I know tough name, but fun name imo to say haha)

Check out the game here: [https://card-forge-lac.vercel.app/](https://card-forge-lac.vercel.app/) (domain will change once I nail it down) 

At it's core, it's a card battler with characters from different universes, combined with a gacha game like gameplay loop.

https://i.redd.it/7g5u87q3xosh1.gif

Back in 2012 I discovered the ComicVine API had a vast majority of information and art about characters that I felt was deep enough that it essentially had the basic building blocks of making a game.

The simplest form of that I could think of was a card game and that's how I came up with the overall idea. What if, Hatsune Miku, and Batman duked it out in a fight... and it reminded me of the old MUGEN fighting game that was so popular amongst the FGC.

https://i.redd.it/cesepff7xosh1.gif

So it went from, how can I use this data just for fun to, building a deck building game with it all.

I originally created the forge (aka the builder) back in 2012 with Angular and Slim framework, I wanted to explore a more modern web stack along with AI assisted development.

https://i.redd.it/1pt2gn7wyosh1.gif

I’d love for people to give it a try and tell me what feels fun, what’s confusing, and where the battles could improve. Feedback on the first-time experience would be especially helpful.

Feel free to ask any questions as well.  
  
**Quick overview:**

**- Build a card**  
\-- Cards have ATK + DEF + Skills + Traits + Types + Rarities  
**- Pull packs of cards made by other players**  
**- Build decks with cards made or pulled**  
**- Battle those decks with other players**  
**- Overall Goal: Have fun playing a game that could possibly set off some hilarious matchups.**

**How I used AI**

\- Claude + ChatGPT on the basic $20/mo plans for AI assisted development.  
\- A few test sounds from elevenlabs  
\- Two Characters have AI generated art as they are custom cards made for my girlfriend and her son for fun.

Originally setup a plan for my AI Agent to take my original project and refactor with a more modern stack. I focused on a web based game as my main job is a web designer/developer and I wanted to force myself to explore an AI workflow while honing my actual skills.

**Timeline**

I've been working on it almost non stop after my time at work or being a single father, it's been about two months so far. It's far from a one prompt. When I run out of usage I continue work, albeit much slower than Claude/Codex and I'm still new to the overall development workflow. If I can't afford my AI plan, the project continues, just much much slower haha.

**Caveats**

Performance, haven't nailed it down yet, but you can turn off features in settings to help.   
  
ComicVine is one of the searchable sources to created a card, however, it has a harsh rate limit, I've tried to gracefully spread that out for players, but it's very likely that even if a few people are on at once using that source, it could go down quickly. In that event use another source for the forge.

*This is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the owners of the featured characters.*
